Name: sugarmaples' Cafe Clothes for Fashion Sense
Author: sugarmaples
Description:
[center]My first mod! Adds 7 shirts and 5 pants, all for fashion sense and all coffee and cafe themed!!
Please see the images for details.

This mod REQUIRES [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ to work. I also recommend using GH's [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]peach body type[/url]﻿ with it, as that's what it's designed for, but it'll *probably* work without it. I *think* this will work for 1.6 and 1.5.6, but if I need to make a seperate version for 1.6 please let me know!! I'm still new to this :-)
Hairs in the preview images are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19125]this mod[/url]﻿ by churpix

I'm working on adding more sprites for more poses in game so the pants don't look odd. Also an update key.

If you have any issues, please contact me on here, [url=https://www.tumblr.com/batmanshole]tumblr[/url]﻿, or on 小红书 (ID:6159772224)

There's also a matcha-themed version of this mod, with some different style outfits (and hats!)

[size=5][b][color=#ff0000]FAQ: please read before commenting![/color][/b]
[/size][size=3]
[b]How do I get these clothes in my game?[/b]
[/size][size=5][/size]You need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]fashion sense[/url]﻿ mod. From there, you need to obtain the mirror item, which you can either start with by toggling that option on character creation (it will be in your mailbox on spring 1 year 1) OR by purchasing it from Pierre's store. I recommend checking out the FS modpage for more info.

[b]Where do I put the files?[/b]
Directly into your mods folder! No need to put them in the Fashion Sense mod's folder, as that won't work. The game needs to read this as it's own mod.

[b]How do I get the sleeves?[/b]
For the sleeves shown in the images, you need [url=https://m.blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH's Peach Body Type[/url]﻿, and from there, open the config with generic mod config menu. There are quite a few settings to play with, so I recommend looking at the mod page on naver to see what the options are.

[b]The peach body type has misaligned shoes / red sleeves / the wrong skin and eye colours[/b]
This happened to me before!! The way I fixed it was by disabling the "horse wings body" option, and any other options relating to the horse body. Sometimes with the red sleeves you just need to reload the mod. Try opening the mod config and hitting "save and close" without changing anything. This usually works for me.

[b]What are your settings for the peach body type?[/b]
﻿﻿Here's an [url=https://imgur.com/a/vgc84He]imgur link[/url]﻿ to 3 screenshots of my settings. (I couldn't figure out how to make it look nice on here...)[/center]
